governance.status: LEVEL 2 — TECHNICALLY VERIFIED, NOT EXTERNALLY ATTESTED
governance.description: Cross-Domain Failure Graph: Mapping our project's specific failure modes to identical historical failures in other fields, their proven solutions, and reverse transfer to CFD.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Fixed snapshot POD fails completely (E_u ≈ 99.9%) on unseen turbulent seeds or perturbed ICs due to random Fourier phase shifts.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Standard POD fails on traveling waves, advection-dominated flows, and shock tubes; Kolmogorov n-width decays extremely slowly (O(1/n) or worse) because moving discontinuities create high apparent rank in linear subspaces.
analogous_failures.key_literature_precedent: Reiss et al. (2018, SIAM J. Sci. Comput.) — Shifted POD; Cagniart, Maday, Stamm (2019) — Model reduction for convection-dominated problems; Rowley & Marsden (2000, Physica D) — Symmetry reduction.
analogous_failures.their_solution: Nonlinear coordinate transformations / registration: Shifted POD (sPOD), transport maps, Lagrangian frame transformations, or quotienting out continuous Lie symmetry group actions (translation/rotation) before performing linear dimension reduction.
analogous_failures.mathematical_reason: Linear subspaces cannot efficiently approximate the manifold generated by translating a localized profile: {u(x - c t) : t in [0, T]}. Factoring out the shift c(t) collapses the multi-dimensional orbit into a single stationary point or limit cycle of rank 1.
analogous_failures.applicability_back_to_our_cfd: HIGH. In homogeneous periodic directions (x, z), turbulent structures advect with mean flow and turbulent eddies undergo random spatial phase shifts. Applying spatial phase alignment / registration (our W4 optimal_translation_alignment) BEFORE basis projection collapses the cross-seed subspace distance from >1.5 down to near zero.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Explicit triad tensor storage scales as O(r^2) to O(r^3) and becomes a memory bottleneck; heuristically truncating weak triads causes catastrophic energy blowup and numerical instability.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Truncating resonant and near-resonant triadic wave interactions in quasi-geostrophic / shallow-water spectral models breaks skew-symmetry, destroys Casimir invariants (energy, enstrophy), and triggers artificial unphysical energy cascades and numerical explosion.
analogous_failures.key_literature_precedent: Schlegel & Noack (2015, J. Fluid Mech.) — Long-term stability of POD-Galerkin models; Majda, Timofeyev, Vanden-Eijnden (2001, J. Atmos. Sci.) — Systematic stochastic mode reduction.
analogous_failures.their_solution: Two distinct solutions: (1) Pseudospectral on-the-fly evaluation using fast transforms on minimal collocation grids without storing tensors; (2) Algebraic skew-symmetrization combined with energy-conserving triad graph regularization and Mori-Zwanzig stochastic closure.
analogous_failures.mathematical_reason: The continuous quadratic advection operator (u·∇)u is skew-symmetric: <u, (u·∇)u> = 0. Any ad-hoc coefficient deletion destroys the exact cancellation <phi_i, (phi_j·∇)phi_k> + <phi_k, (phi_j·∇)phi_i> = 0, turning a neutrally stable conservative nonlinearity into an unstable positive-feedback loop.
analogous_failures.applicability_back_to_our_cfd: VERY HIGH. Fully explains why our W7 OntheFlyFFTEvaluator (R11) succeeded (it preserved the full continuous operator without truncation) while explicit triad pruning failed (N06). Validates that all future spectral nonlinearities must use pseudospectral evaluation or strictly skew-symmetric triad graphs.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Derivative-weighted mode selection (W9-A/B) successfully improved wall-shear stress error (E_tau_w dropped), but severely degraded global velocity field error (E_u > 1.0) because wall-gradient modes displaced bulk kinetic energy modes.
analogous_failures.analogous_field: Structural Acoustics & Goal-Oriented Finite Element / ROM Methods
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: In goal-oriented / output-specific model reduction (e.g., predicting acoustic sound pressure at a far-field point, or stress concentration at a notch), standard energy-norm POD fails because energy is dominated by bulk structural modes that contribute zero to the local target observable.
analogous_failures.key_literature_precedent: Brunton & Noack (2015, Appl. Mech. Rev.) — Closed-loop turbulence control; Willcox & Peraire (2002, AIAA J.) — Balanced truncation for CFD; Rozza, Huynh, Patera (2008, Arch. Comput. Methods Eng.) — Reduced basis for outputs.
analogous_failures.their_solution: Dual/adjoint-weighted Petrov-Galerkin projection and balanced truncation: explicitly decouple the trial space (representing the state) from the test space (weighted by the adjoint sensitivity of the output functional).
analogous_failures.mathematical_reason: The L2 energy norm and the H1 wall-gradient seminorm induce non-commuting operator metrics. Truncating a single orthogonal basis under one norm is guaranteed to be suboptimal (and often adversarial) under the other. Dual-space Petrov-Galerkin methods resolve this by using separate basis pairs.
analogous_failures.applicability_back_to_our_cfd: HIGH. Re-interprets our W9-A/B result: the method did NOT fail as an observable estimator—it failed because we forced an output-specific mode ranking into a global Galerkin projection. Implementing Petrov-Galerkin projection (adjoint test modes) would preserve global stability while retaining accurate wall-shear recovery.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Global separable Fourier-sine eigenwaves hit an intrinsic representation floor (E_proj ≈ 18%-24%) at moderate ranks (r ~ 200-300), and even greedy global oracle selection failed to achieve 5% error within r=1152 modes.
analogous_failures.analogous_field: Image Processing, Compressed Sensing & Multiscale PDE Analysis
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Fourier basis exhibits slow convergence (Gibbs phenomenon and dense high-frequency tails) when representing spatially localized features, sharp gradients, edges, and intermittency. Global sines/cosines require O(N) modes to resolve features of spatial width 1/N.
analogous_failures.key_literature_precedent: Mallat (1999) — A Wavelet Tour of Signal Processing; Farge & Schneider (2001, Phys. Fluids) — Coherent vortex extraction using orthogonal wavelets; Donoho (2006, IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory) — Compressed sensing.
analogous_failures.their_solution: Multiresolution Analysis (MRA), localized wavelets, curvelets, and overcomplete dictionaries with sparse l1/greedy pursuit (matching pursuit, OMP).
analogous_failures.mathematical_reason: Localized, intermittent structures have high sparsity in multiresolution / wavelet dictionaries (few non-zero localized coefficients) but are completely dense in global Fourier dictionaries (every Fourier mode has non-zero overlap with a localized pulse).
analogous_failures.applicability_back_to_our_cfd: VERY HIGH. Confirms the fundamental premise of W13-G: multiscale spatial localization is mathematically necessary to break the global Fourier capacity barrier. The issue in W13R-V2 was measurement/reproduction integrity, not the underlying mathematical principle.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Ramanujan-inspired spectral correction failed to improve turbulence prediction on continuous MAC grids.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Applying discrete number-theoretic transforms (Ramanujan sums, Farey fractions) directly to continuous differential operators yields no spectral advantage because Ramanujan sums are designed for integer periodicities and arithmetic divisibility, not spatial Laplacian eigenvalues.
analogous_failures.key_literature_precedent: Vaidyanathan & Tenneti (2014, IEEE Trans. Signal Process.) — Ramanujan filter banks; Tenneti & Vaidyanathan (2015) — Nested periodic subspaces.
analogous_failures.their_solution: Restrict Ramanujan transforms to their natural domain: identifying exact integer periods, repetitive pattern matching in DNA/protein sequences, machine vibration harmonic monitoring, and discrete clock-cycle signal processing.
analogous_failures.mathematical_reason: Ramanujan sums c_q(n) form an orthogonal basis for signals of period q over integer indices n under number-theoretic gcd inner products. They do not diagonalize continuous or finite-difference differential operators on Euclidean spaces.
analogous_failures.applicability_back_to_our_cfd: LOW FOR CFD / HIGH FOR DISCRETE TIME SERIES. Ramanujan transforms should be permanently retired from continuous spatial fluid modeling, but our implementation can be directly repurposed for discrete machinery vibration diagnostics and engine cycle periodicity detection.
